fusions.name: Roll Under
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. You pin its neck under the staff and roll: it deals 20 damage, consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit, and makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wedged Jaw
fusions.desc: Jams the staff upright between the target's jaws. It deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stick-Propped Snare
fusions.desc: Sets a pair of jaws at the nearest enemy, propped open on a length of staff. It waits up to 20 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles knocks the prop out: the jaws deal 18 damage and leave it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Log at the Waterline
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
